cohort: The study comprised 17,065 primiparous women with singleton, cephalic deliveries at 37-43 weeks of gestation registered in the Georgian Birth Registry in 2017.
finding: The proportion of cesarean section was 37.1%, and increased maternal age, obesity, and having a baby weighing >=4000 g were all associated with higher odds of cesarean section.
mod_finding: Increased maternal age, obesity, and having a baby weighing >=4000 g were associated with higher odds of cesarean section among primiparous women.
